question: Find 5 Indian B2B SaaS startups in HR tech and summarize their positioning.
short_answer: Five prominent Indian HR tech SaaS companies are Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR, Zimyo, and Leena AI, addressing needs ranging from enterprise HCM to mid-market payroll and AI employee experience.

key_findings.finding: Darwinbox positions itself as an enterprise-grade Human Capital Management (HCM) suite, competing directly with Workday and SAP SuccessFactors in Asian markets.
Keka focuses on SME and mid-market organizations, emphasizing intuitive payroll, employee engagement, and modern UX.
greytHR is an established player specializing in statutory compliance, payroll automation, and core HR for Indian SMEs.
Zimyo provides an integrated HRMS, payroll, and employee financial wellness platform tailored for emerging businesses.
Leena AI positions as an autonomous agent and conversational AI platform for employee service delivery and HR helpdesk automation.
